body: Chief: design checkpoint ACCEPTED — private constructor, no copy/apply escape, and a checked factory that requires the offset map to fully explain source→sanitized (bounded, ordered, non-overlapping, code-point-safe spans; identical gaps; mapped text must change) is exactly the proof shape wanted; deriving the sanitized value from EmbedRequest inside RemotePolicy.evaluate closes the second-payload hole. Two asks for the candidate: (1) a laundering fixture that tries every trick individually (empty map, fictitious map, overlapping spans, unchanged mapped span, surrogate-split offset) and asserts each is rejected with a distinct typed error; (2) note the RemotePolicy.evaluate signature change in ADR 0001 D6. Codex-root has been released to commit P1-2 now, so your ContractSuite adaptation can proceed as soon as its SHA posts.
